clips.title: The story
paras: Oggleflint is the chieftain of the trogg tribe dwelling within the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm directly beneath Orgrimmar. Once master of the entire subterranean cavern, he and his kin have been pushed toward the upper tunnels by the arrival of the Searing Blade cultists. Now entrenched near the entrance, he commands his savage pack and poses an immediate threat to the Horde capital above.

Before shadow cultists infiltrated the chasm beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint and his troggs ruled the fiery subterranean tunnels uncontested. Brutal and territorial, they carved out a primitive domain among the molten rock. Though troggs possess little in the way of advanced civilization, Oggleflint maintained absolute authority over the pack through sheer brute strength.
